hooks.command: json=$(cat); printf '%s' "$json" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/memoryctl.py" worktree >/dev/null || true; printf '%s' "$json" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/memoryctl.py" index || true; { [ -n "${CLAUDE_ENV_FILE}" ] && printf '%s' "$json" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/memoryctl.py" env >> "${CLAUDE_ENV_FILE}"; } || true; printf '%s' "$json" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/memoryctl.py" compile || true
json=$(cat); printf '%s' "$json" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/memoryctl.py" index || true; printf '%s' "$json" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/memoryctl.py" session-end || true

json=$(cat); printf '%s' "$json" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/memoryctl.py" validate && printf '%s' "$json" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/memoryctl.py" system-delta && printf '%s' "$json" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/memoryctl.py" commit
